# Import Libraries
```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)
library(PerformanceAnalytics)
options(scipen = 999)
```

## Correlation Plots
```{r cor plots}
# Correlogram
{ # open pdf graphics driver
  pdf(file = "Figures/YSI/04-Correlations/01-YSI-Correlogram.pdf")
  # make correlation plot
  corrplot(cor_mat, type = "upper", order = "hclust", 
           tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, mar = c(0, 0, 5, 0),
           title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Water Quality Correlations")
  # close graphics driver
  dev.off()
}

# Correlogram with Significance
cor_mat_stats$P[is.na(cor_mat_stats$P)] <- 1 #turn NAs into 1's (insignificant)
{ # open pdf graphics driver
  pdf(file = "Figures/YSI/04_Correlations/02-YSI-Correlogram-PValues.pdf")
  corrplot(cor_mat_stats$r, type="upper", order="hclust", 
           tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, mar = c(0, 1, 5, 0),
           p.mat = cor_mat_stats$P, sig.level = 0.05, insig = "blank",
           title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Water Quality Significant Correlations \n
           P-Value < 0.05")
  # close graphics driver
  dev.off()
}

# Heat Map
col<- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(20) #get colors
{ # open pdf graphics driver
  pdf(file = "Figures/YSI/04_Correlations/03-YSI-HeatMap.pdf")
  heatmap(x = cor_mat, col = col, symm = TRUE,
          title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Water Quality Heat Map", 
          margins = c(12,12))
  # close graphics driver
  dev.off()
}

```
